BiblicalUsage: Ophel was the fortified ridge in Jerusalem, the high ground by the temple that the kings built up and repaired. Jotham built much on the wall of Ophel, and the Nethinim dwelt at Ophel by the water gate, while Manasseh raised the wall higher still.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Ophel stands for the strength of the city God chose: kings fortified it, but the true defence of Jerusalem was always the Lord who dwelt there.
